action: full-gate re-measure run 1/2 (GH-835): git-clone checkout of development b2c307b4 under /tmp, ./validate.sh parallel 4-wide, identity bracket before/after
result: RED 413/414 in 1030 s: gh649-pdda-migration.sh failed twice in 0.0 s (resolver). Identity bracket clean (HEAD/porcelain/origin/core.bare unchanged). Root cause found and witnessed: the clone sat under /tmp, a macOS symlink — the suite computes ROOT with a logical pwd while find-pdda.sh resolves with cd -P (physical), so /tmp/... != /private/tmp/... and the string assert fails. Same suite passes from a $HOME clone (verified alone before run 2).
qualification: failed run, environment-induced (clone location); recorded rather than discarded — a /tmp clone location is a real flake trigger for this suite
